notes.title: Poly 1.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Overview[/b][/h1]
Hey guys this is hard to say but I’ve come to the decision that this update will be the final update to poly, thank you all so much for the support and input you’ve had on the development of this game. It's been a really fun experience developing this as my first major game, but as new projects come and go I feel like I should wrap this game up once and for all.

Challenges are unfortunately not coming to poly, however this update is adding sprites for ALL items, as well as fixing a lot of game-breaking bugs to be better for all :D


[h1][b]Additions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Icon For Item “Splinter Shot”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Skill Master”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Skill Up”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Scouts Honor”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Ricochet”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Psychic Collective”
[*] Added Icon For Item “Invigorating Rally”
[*] 
[/list]
[h1][b]Fixes + Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed “Challenges” Menu
[*] Fixed game breaking bug a lot of you were encountering upon first play
[/list]

Anyways that's it for Poly, once again, thank you all for playing and be sure to look out for more of my projects!

Happy fighting
Joe

notes.title: Poly 0.6
notes.content:
[h1] Overview [/h1]

Welcome To The Poly 0.6 Update, development went cold for a few months, I decided to focus a lot on my university work however we are so back baby!
Ive had alot to ponder about where I should take this game, and a lot of you shared valuable feedback in the form of reviews on the steam page!

This update was the culmination of the communities great ideas to improve on the game's mechanics to make it more fun, and the weird ideas I've had while awake at 2am for no good reason, no matter how these ideas came to fruition, they've been added and are making the game more interesting to play!

If any of you have ideas for items from now on, I would highly encourage you to share ideas in Poly’s steam community page, I will do my best to read your ideas and implement them.

anyways, enough of the ramblings, ON TO THE ADDITIONS AND CHANGES! 

[h1] Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added New Item “Collision”
[*]Added New Item “Iced Tea”
[*]Added New Item “Steel Heart”
[*]Added New Item “Old Demons Crown”
[*]Added New Items “Knife And Fork”, “Rifling”, And “Aerodynamics”, And “Spoon” Thanks [i]Snay[/i]
[*]Added Foil Variant For Item “Dual Vision”
[*]Added New Card Sway Animations, Taken Inspiration From [i]Balatro[/i]
[*]Added Item Icon For “Collision”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Iced Tea”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Steel Heart”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Knife And Fork”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Aerodynamics”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Spoon”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Rabbits Foot”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Heavy Rounds”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Shrapnel”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Shrinking Shots”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Vampiric Bullets”
[*]Added Item Icon For “Old Demons Crown”
[*]Added Item Display, Allows Players To See What Items They Have Collected Throughout The Run, Updates To This Panel To Come
[*]Added Enemy Item Display, Allows Players To See What Items Enemies Have Above Enemies Heads
[/list]

[h1]Changes + Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed Description Text On Item “Vitality Engine”
[*] Changed Description Text On Item “Demise”
[*] Fixed Description Text On Item “Goliath Rounds”
[*] Fixed Description Text On Item “Psychic Collective”
[*] Fixed Description Text On Item “Shrapnel”
[*] Changed Icon On Item “Steroids”
[*] Changed Icon On Item “Four Leaf Clover”
[*] Changed Rarity On “Burning Rubber” From Rare To Uncommon
[*] Decreased Faster Chambering From +1 Fire Rate To + 0.5 Fire Rate
[*] Increased 4 Leaf Clover From +2 Luck To +4 Luck
[*] Fixed Shrinking Shots To Now Disappear Over TIme Rather Than Distance, THis Is More Performant
[*] Fixed Ricochet Inner Visual Pulse Not Automatically Playing
[*] Item “Dual Vision” Now Stacks, Increasing The Number Of Copies Added To Your Inventory
[*] Item “Bloody Anger Now Stacks”, Increasing Amount Of Temporary Damage Gained
[*] Item “Splinter Shots” deals more damage after splits
[*] Item “Countdown” Now Stacks, Does The Same As Having Multiple Countdowns
[*] Item “Lots Of Friends” Is Now Limited To 10 Minions
[*] Item “Burning Rubber” Caps At Bullet Speed 25
[*] Clumsy Akimbo Now Gives Gun Based On What Character Is Played As


[*] Changed The Way Item Rarities Work, Should Be More Performant As Well As More Balanced, Rarer Items Feel Rare To Get
[*] Damage Tick-Based Effects Such As Blight And Poison Now Have A Duration Set By The Item, Poison Is 30 Seconds While Blight Is Only 10 Seconds
[*] Changed In-Game Background
[*] Player Luck Now Contributes To The Rarity Of Item Found
[*] Decreased Foil Chance From 33% To 5%, This Is A Significant Change So I Will Monitor How The Community Responds To This Change
[*] Enemies Can Now Spawn With Items, This Adds More Variety Later Into The Game, Because Of This, There Are Also Less Enemies, Making Later Rounds Less Laggy
[*] Penta-Snipers Now Follow The Player To Get Closer Before Shooting, This Also Means That They Take less Knockback From Bullets Sending Them Flying
[*] Fixed Enemies Dropping Multiple XP Orbs On Death
[*] Fixed Card Scaling On The Post-Round Items Screen
[*] XP Orbs Now Have A Pickup Sound
[*] Fixed Overlap Between Buttons On The Game Over Screen
[*] Changed Active Item Skill Bar To Disable When The Players Active Item Is Null

[/list]

[h2] Conclusion [/h2]
Anyways that's it for this update, rebranding and major gameplay changes… can't wait to see what the game evolves into next

Happy fighting
Joe

notes.title: POLY 0.5 Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, a massive update just dropped for poly!

A lot of OP items and abilities just launched into the game and I'm excited to see what runs people craft with these additions!

Additions Including :
 - Ultimate abilities :
       - A Massive Death Laser
       - Fire rate Boosters
      - A Lightning Zap

- A Electrician Minion
- Bottle Opener Item : You'll See :P
- Minion Buffers
- Foil Variants Of Cards Which Have Doubled/Upgraded Effects

I also made the game a lot more visually appealing with BRAND new particle effect upgrades

Happy Fighting
- Joe

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h1]POLY 0.3 Update + Mac Support Rollout[/h1]

[h2] MAC Support Comes To Poly! [/h2]
over the past week, I have been testing the mac support of the game to make sure that the rollout on mac devices is as smooth as it was for windows! :D, I had a few last minute issues for Mac Support working but hopefully its all fixed now, don't be afraid to join the discord and let me know if there's still issues :D

and after this week I am happy to announce that mac support is coming to poly as of today!

Also I have been working on a ton of new content for the game :P

NEW CHARACTER! Meet the electrician, he zaps enemies with his tesla coil and arcs electricity between them!

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Flawless Achievement, unlocks new item
[*] Added Revitalize Item
[*] Added Lots Of Friends Item
[*] Added Pre And Post Round Informational Flash Text
[*] Added Arc Shot Item (New Bullet Behavior)
[*] Certain Items Stacks In Unique Ways
[*] Grenadier Grenades Now Damage Enemies On Hit, Triggering Items On Hit Effects 
[*] Added Burning Rubber Item
[*] Added How To Play Before Each Game
[*] Added Difficulty Colors For EVERY Difficulty Not Just The First And Last One
[*] Added A List Of Previous Runs Played In The Stats Menu
[/list]

[h2]Fixes + Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bloodlust now works as Intended, 55% chance at luck 100 to increase max health by 1 on enemy kill
[*] Fixed Settings Screen Options Having Multiple Options For Each Resolution
[*] Fixed Poison Field Not Triggering The OnEnemyDamaged Effect On Items
[*] Fixed Correct Spelling Of Death Messages
[*] Fixed Alignment Of Text On Game Over Screen
[*] Fixed Stats Menu Showing Total Of All Players Enemy Kill Count Instead Of The Local Players'
[*] Changed Character Selection To Carousel Instead Of Clamp
[*] Changed Items Descriptions To Be More Specific
[*] Changed Four Leaf Clover To Increase Luck By 2 Instead Of 0.5
[*] Increase Based Speed Of All Characters

[*] Poison Field Becomes Larger The More Poison Fields Your Character Holds
[*] Arc Shot Arcs Between More Enemies The More Arc Shots Your Character Holds
[*] Bloodlust Increases Max Health By A Larger Amount The More Bloodlusts you Hold
[/list]


[h3]Links[/h3]
[list]
[*] Join The Discord To Get Involved : https://discord.gg/TVTkzBwkjX
[/list]

notes.title: Poly Is Released To Public!
notes.content:
[h1] Release Day Is Here [/h1]

I just want to say a big thank you to all those who wishlisted the game before launch!, your support of very meaningful to me and ill do my best to bring the game to high standards!

I wanted to use this announcement to lay out the current roadmap and plan in the near future and highlight some of the current features in the game in its current state.

Current Features
- 3 playable characters,
- 45+ items, which synergize with each other resulting in powerful combinations
- 4 Unlockable achievements,
- Endless round gameplay

it dosen't sound like much, but there's a lot of gameplay in this version to get through, so get shootin!

The Near Future Additions :  
- Level System + Boss Fights
- Unlockable Items + Characters
- Challenges
- Procedural Items (Randomly generated for each run)

These additions are likely to be added before or during Christmas time, so a lot to add in the next month and a half so keep your eyes peeled for updates and more dev blogs to come!
